name: windrunner
description: Surgebinders who command Gravitation and Adhesion. Swift, loyal, and bound by oaths to protect, they fly through the air and strike like the storm.
sprenDescription: A small, luminous figure of blue-white light with a humanoid shape. Honorspren are fiercely loyal, idealistic, and deeply protective of their bonded Radiant.

ideals.label: first ideal
ideals.description: The universal Ideal shared by all Radiants. A pledge to value life, seek strength for the right reasons, and walk a path of purpose over outcome.
quotes: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination.

ideals.label: second ideal
ideals.description: The Windrunner accepts their duty as a guardian, vowing to defend the innocent and powerless without hesitation.
quotes: I will protect those who cannot protect themselves.

ideals.label: third ideal
ideals.description: The Windrunner expands their protection to all, even enemies and the undeserving, recognizing that justice demands compassion without bias.
quotes: I will protect even those I hate, so long as it is right.
I will protect those I hate. Even...even if the one I hate most is... myself.
I've got to protect people, you know? Even from myself.

ideals.label: fourth ideal
ideals.description: A painful admission that not all can be saved. The Windrunner accepts their limits and continues to act despite inevitable failure.
quotes: I accept that there will be those I cannot protect!

ideals.label: fifth ideal
ideals.description: The culmination of the Windrunner's journey: acknowledging their own worth, and the necessity of self-preservation in the service of others.
quotes: I will protect myself, so that I may continue to protect others.
